grades.A: Derived from an official dimension, an archival drawing, or an authoritative published dataset.
grades.B: Derived from multiple consistent photographs or imagery combined with known control geometry.
grades.C: Derived from an existing mesh, from photogrammetry aligned to control, or reconstructed from a proxy attribute.
grades.D: Inferred, decorative, or placeholder. Never citable as a dimension.

tier_rule: No Tier C source may override Tier A geometry.
